edges.reason: _price parameter is consumed by createBet requirements and stored in the Bet struct.
coinSide parameter is consumed by createBet and stored in the Bet struct.
msg.sender is recorded as the bet creator in activeBets and in BetCreated.
createBet pushes a new Bet into activeBets.
createBet increments betCount to assign the new bet id.
createBet writes the array index into the bets mapping.
_id parameter selects the bet to cancel.
cancelBet requires bet.b1 == msg.sender to authorise the refund.
The local Bet copy is loaded from activeBets via bets[_id].
lock guards cancelBet entry.
cancelBet performs an external ETH transfer to the bet creator.
The refund transfer goes to msg.sender, allowing a malicious caller to re-enter.
lock is reset only after the external transfer completes (check-effects-interactions ordering).
_id parameter selects the bet to join.
msg.sender is the joiner, used for the own-bet check and as potential winner.
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender as an anti-bot check.
now (block.timestamp) feeds the flip randomness value.
joinBet computes flip from gasleft() and now to decide the winner.
joinBet sends the commission to owner via external call.
joinBet sends the winnings to bet.b1 via external call before resetting lock.
The flip result determines which side wins and therefore the payout.
commission is derived from total (2x bet price) and fees.
The resolved Bet is pushed into the winners array.
val parameter determines the amount transferred in withdraw.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner before withdraw.
withdraw performs an external ETH transfer to owner.
onlyOwner guards kill.
kill executes selfdestruct(owner).
newFees parameter is assigned to the fees state variable.
onlyOwner guards feesDown.
feesDown writes the fees state variable.
newMin parameter is assigned to the min state variable.
onlyOwner guards minDown.
minDown writes the min state variable.
Constructor argument _owner is stored.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable.
Fallback accepts incoming Ether, increasing the balance later paid out by owner transfers.

normalization_plan.reason: _price is only meaningful as the amount argument of createBet.
coinSide is only meaningful as the side argument of createBet.
index is only used to read a winners array entry in getWinner.
_id is only used to locate and validate the bet inside cancelBet.
_id is only used to locate and validate the bet inside joinBet.
val is only the amount passed to the owner transfer in withdraw.
newFees is only written into the fees state variable by feesDown.
newMin is only written into the min state variable by minDown.
_owner is only used to initialise the owner state variable.
The memory copy of Bet exists only within cancelBet's refund logic.
The memory copy of Bet exists only within joinBet's resolution logic.
flip is a transient randomness value local to joinBet.
total is the intermediate 2x prize value computed in joinBet.
commission is the intermediate fee value computed in joinBet.
